title: feat(types,react,core,plugin-dashboard)!: a node slot and SchemaRenderer's `schema` prop take the declared-node union, V1; the dashboard producers name declared nodes and an envelope's object-metric retires (objectui#11466)
body:
Fixes #11466

This PR carries ruling ① (V1) and the card's residue, with `main` merged in, the plugin-dashboard producers closed, and the maintainer's ruling A on the last inline metric form (comment 5966278275). The census reads 0 lines across all 88 workspace type-check programs, with `BaseSchema`'s index signature present.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

**objectui#11543 (governed PR #11558) has landed** as `5cde2c6fe`. `Skill Example Check` is green at `cae2224d5`: 18 of 18 ts fences judged, 0 failed. All 43 check-runs on this head are green or expected skips.

## What changes

- `@object-ui/types` exports `DeclaredNode`. It is the discriminated union, keyed by the literal `type`, of:
  - every component schema `AnySchema` declares, minus its `BaseSchema` arm (whose `type` is `string`) and minus the app-level document, which is left out by `{ type: 'app' }` (`AppSchemaRenderer` reads that document structurally and `ComponentRegistry` never dispatches it);
  - every spec-declared `AuthoringNode`;
  - every entry of the new `CustomNodeRegistry` interface. An entry joins under its KEY: the arm is the entry intersected with `{ type: KEY }`, so even a loose entry adds no `type: string` arm.
- `SchemaNode` is `DeclaredNode | string | number | boolean | null | undefined`. It was `BaseSchema | string | number | boolean | null | undefined`.
- `SchemaRendererProps['schema']` is `DeclaredNode | string | null | undefined`. It was `BaseSchema | AuthoringNode | string | null | undefined`. `toRenderableSchema` follows by reference.
- `@object-ui/core`'s schema builder takes `DeclaredNode` where it took `BaseSchema`: `.child()` and `.children()` on the grid and flex builders, and the card builder's `.content()`.
- `@object-ui/components`' `kind: 'html'` page crosses its runtime-parsed tree into `DeclaredNode` at ONE documented boundary, right after `validateTree` reports no error (`page.tsx`, objectui#11479 Q2 A). No other cast to `DeclaredNode` exists under `src/`.
- `@object-ui/test-support` gains `undeclaredNode`, the one crossing for deliberately undeclared test input (objectui#11479 Q3 A). It has 25 call sites in 15 test files, and none outside tests.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`:**
  - `plugin-dashboard:metric` is declared through `CustomNodeRegistry` (objectui#11479 Q1 A). `DashboardMetricNodeSchema`, a new export, is the node `MetricWidget` renders under that key, with the keys it reads off the node, typed by `MetricWidgetProps`. `widgetDispatch.ts` enters it in the registry beside `DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES`, whose values are now literal types (a string-keyed view serves the by-type lookup). The package entry exports the type, so its published typings load the declaration.
  - Both surfaces' node builders (`getComponentSchema` in `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout`) return `SchemaRendererProps['schema']`, so each node is checked against its declared type where it is built. The metric arms narrow `widgetType` for the required label; `classifyWidgetType` answers `metric` only for a named type, so no verdict moves.
  - `DashboardGridLayout`'s static `pivot` node states the keys `PivotTable` draws (its `PivotTableSchema` keys, and `className`), read from `options`, instead of spreading `options` whole, so it names `PivotTableSchema` with no cast.
  - The casts before `SchemaRenderer` are gone: `as BaseSchema | string | null | undefined` in `DashboardGridLayout` and `as BaseSchema` in `DashboardRenderer`. No new cast.
  - **An `object-metric` node in a widget's legacy `component` envelope draws `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA` on both surfaces** (the maintainer's ruling A on objectui#11466, extending ruling C on objectui#11525), under its bare key and under `plugin-dashboard:object-metric`, and sends no query. One shared detector, `isRetiredEnvelopeNode` in `legacyRetiredWidget.ts`, is read by both surfaces before the envelope pass-through, and the placeholder is the same imported object the metric and pivot arms return. `object-metric` leaves the filter broadcast's `FilterableComponentType` / `FILTERABLE_COMPONENT_TYPES`, so the flat-`filter` write the declared `object-metric` node refuses is gone. The broadcast now covers `object-chart` and `object-data-table`, built by the renderer or written in an envelope.
- Not here: a `type: string` arm, an index signature, a transitional `BaseSchema` arm, `BaseSchema`'s own index signature, and the `component` slot's `BaseSchema` fallback (all objectui#8347's). Every zod face and every TypeScript authoring face of `object-metric` stays as it was, and so does the authored `object-metric` block on a page. Two runtime moves, both in `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: an option key the static pivot does not state no longer reaches its node, and an envelope's `object-metric` draws the rebind prompt.

## The accept set, before and after (TypeScript face only)

Judged by `packages/types/src/__tests__/node-slot-union-11466.test.ts`, by the react prop pin, and by the premise probes below.

- **Undeclared `type`, nested or at the prop**, e.g. `{ type: 'card', children: [{ type: 'txt' }] }`. Before: compiles through the `BaseSchema` arm. After: TS2322.
- **A value typed `BaseSchema`** at the prop or in a slot. Before: compiles. After: refused, because it names no declared type.
- **A misspelled key on a closed node type** (an `AuthoringNode`, or a closed `CustomNodeRegistry` entry), nested at any depth. Before: compiles through the `BaseSchema` arm. After: refused, because the slot discriminates on `type`.
- **A misspelled key on a node type that extends `BaseSchema`.** Before: compiles. After: still compiles, through that type's own index signature, until objectui#8347 removes it. Measured below as the signature-present control leg.
- **A missing REQUIRED key.** Before: compiles through the `BaseSchema` arm. After: refused. Examples: a stored `home` page without `label`, a `data-table` without `columns`, a static `pivot` without its axes.
- **A registered custom type.** Before: any `type` compiled. After: it compiles once declared in `CustomNodeRegistry`; an unregistered one is refused.
- **A `plugin-dashboard:metric` node.** Before: compiled through the `BaseSchema` arm, like any string. After: in a program that loads `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`'s typings it is a declared node, checked against `DashboardMetricNodeSchema` (which extends `BaseSchema`, so a misspelled key still compiles until objectui#8347); in one that does not, it is refused as undeclared.
- **Narrowing on `type`.** `'app'` narrows to `PageDocumentNode` (the stored page kind) and `'list'` to `ListSchema`. `PageDocumentNode` excludes the interface-mode `list` kind, which `PageView` renders through `InterfaceListPage` and never hands to `SchemaRenderer`. `SchemaByType` reads `AnySchema` and does not move.

- **Landing-prep round (director seat, claim `5970151706`; dev report `5970915352`):** two more merge commits, both conflict-free, with `pnpm install` leaving the lockfile unchanged.
  - `5afa0269a` merges `main` `154075ab1`: objectui#11533, the `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 bump objectui#11531, objectui#11547, #11539, #11542, objectui#11344 and objectui#11068.
  - `cb687dfad` merges `d0c0c7fe9`, objectui#10813.

  `main` brought no new V1 producer.

- **Final landing round (report `5974814539`):**
  - `318447867` merges `main` `0a53c67f9` (16 squash commits, objectui#11543 among them). There is no conflict and no conflict-resolution edit inside this PR's 88 files, and the lockfile is unchanged. The merge brought 105 files, two of them shared with this PR (`schema-reference.md`, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`), both auto-merged with only `main`'s change.
  - `cae2224d5` corrects `MeasuredArmDrift11466`'s docblock (contract review R1, prose only): the `app` / `record` / `home` / `utility` / `page` / `dashboard` drifts are recorded for objectui#8347's family, not carried by their own cards.

## H1: the cycle

- **Before**, with the V1 candidate on the first base (`tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.json`), there were 9 errors: TS2456 on `FlexBlockNode`, `AuthoringNode`, `DeclaredNode` and `SchemaNode`; TS4109 in `zod/base.zod.ts`; TS7022 on `FlexSchema`, `FLEX_BAG_CHILDREN`, `FlexPropsBag` and `FlexBlockSchema`.
- **The spelling:** `FlexBlockNode` is an interface that extends the closed arm input of `FlexBlockSchema`, with no members of its own; `zod/base.zod.ts` writes the node slot's zod type out through two type aliases (`SchemaNodeZodType`, `NodeSlotZodType`). The schema objects do not change.
- **After:** 0 errors in `tsconfig.json` and in `tsconfig.examples.json`, on the merged tree as well.

## H3: premise ②, re-run on the merged tree

> **Superseded reading (contract review R3):** the figures below were taken at `b13093d6`. Re-measured at `cb687dfad` under the objectui#8347 mutation: types 39/40 and react 15/15. The one row is f02, the flex bag's ARRAY child list, which is `unknown[]` on the TS face and carried by objectui#11564. See the corrected acceptance note.

Throwaway probe files, never committed: 40 type-level rows in `@object-ui/types` and 15 in `@object-ui/react`, each labelled OK (must compile) or REFUSE (must error), each run on two legs at `b13093d6`.

So (a) a nested misspelling is refused at every slot depth and at the prop, and (b) a registered custom type is authorable, its misspelling refused, and its keys do not escape onto a declared type.
- **Signature present** (the control, and what lands now): types 29 of 40, react 9 of 15, the same rows as at the first fork. Every row that does not pass is a misspelling on a node type that extends `BaseSchema`, which is the signature objectui#8347 removes. Undeclared types, wrong-value keys, the tombstone, `AuthoringNode` bag misspellings and unregistered custom types are refused on both legs.

## The envelope's `object-metric` (the maintainer's ruling A)

The previous round held one line: the filter broadcast kept `object-metric` in its filterable set for a node in a widget's legacy `component` envelope (objectui#11525 kept it), and wrote a flat `filter` that the declared `object-metric` node (the spec's `properties` bag, `ObjectMetricBlockNode`) refuses by name on both faces. The maintainer ruled A (comment 5966278275): that envelope node is the last inline metric form, retired as ruling C retired the rest.

- **Measured basis (from the report):** an `object-metric` inside a `component` envelope appears in 1 file across objectui and objectstack, the objectui#11525 pin itself, against a control of 3 files holding an envelope of another type. Stored customer dashboards are unmeasured, the gap ruling C accepted.
- **The pin.** `inlineObjectMetricRetired-11525.test.tsx` carries a dated note in its header. Its envelope case flips: on both surfaces, under both keys, the envelope node yields the placeholder object (checked by identity), the prompt is on screen, and no `aggregate` or `find` call is made. A new control keeps the broadcast on the envelope's `object-chart` and `object-data-table`, which still receive the filter bar's value.
- **Reverse verification**, run on the committed fix (`20fb2278`) with a trap-restored mutation. `isRetiredEnvelopeNode` was forced false (anchor hit once, marker on disk 1, blob `71c7335c` to `c2706404`). Expected direction: the four retired-envelope cases red and everything else green. Read: "Tests 4 failed | 30 passed (34)", exactly those four (both keys on both surfaces). Restore: blob `71c7335c` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, marker 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Corrected (landing-prep round, report `5970915352`):** the flex bag's child list is `unknown[] | SchemaNode` on the TS face. A SINGLE child is checked, and under the objectui#8347 mutation a misspelled key on it is refused (the earlier f03). An ARRAY of children is `unknown[]` and unchecked (probe f02 compiles under the mutation, at `cb687dfad` and at `fab635a2`). That comes from `FLEX_BAG_CHILDREN`'s `z.array(z.unknown())` arm, which is on `main` and untouched here. With the signature present, no reading moves today. The arm is carried by objectui#11564, ordered before objectui#8347's removal PR (seat ruling A on the report's open question).
- **Premise H3, re-measured at `cb687dfad`:** under the P1 mutation, types reads 39/40 (f02, the array arm above) and react 15/15. The control leg reads 29/40 and 9/15.
- `DeclaredNode` has same-`type` pairs that are intended: `flex` (`FlexSchema` and `FlexBlockNode`) and the `object-*` renderer faces next to their authored bag nodes.
- The static pivot's runtime move: an option key it does not state (a host prop of `PivotTable`'s such as `rowLabels`, or a `BaseSchema` node key other than `className` such as `id`, `style` or `hidden`) no longer reaches the node. Each stated key draws as before; `DashboardGridLayout.objectProviderFetch-10528` and `DashboardGridLayout.datasetPath` pass.
- `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` keeps twelve stale cross-file line addresses, none in a paragraph this PR edits, so they are listed on the card for a later edit of that file rather than repaired here: four in the `dataSource` prop's docblock (into `DashboardRenderer`, `DatasetWidget`, and `SchemaRenderer` twice) and eight in the render-site comments (five into `DashboardRenderer`, three into `legacyRetiredWidget`).
